official: 横浜市一般職職員の特殊勤務手当に関する条例の一部改正

sources.label: 議案一覧（令和8年第1回定例会）

name: 災害派遣手当と教員手当を改定
summary: 現在、災害応急対策等派遣手当は日額840円で、避難指示などが出た区域では日額1,680円です。教員特殊業務手当は、対象となる業務や従事時間に応じて支給額が定められています。この議案で手当額と時間区分を改め、令和8年4月1日から適用します。
changes: 災害応急対策等派遣手当を日額840円から1,080円にし、午後6時から翌日午前6時までの業務は日額1,620円にする
避難指示などが出た区域での手当を日額1,680円から2,160円にする
教員特殊業務手当の時間区分を6時間から4時間にし、日額7,500円と7,000円をいずれも8,000円にする
who: 災害応急対策等に従事する市職員
非常災害時などの緊急業務に従事する教員
why: 災害応急対策等に従事した場合の手当額と、非常災害時などの緊急業務に従事した教員の手当額・時間区分を改めるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Revises disaster deployment and teacher allowances
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Special Duty Allowances for Yokohama City General Service Employees
en.summary: The current Disaster Emergency Response, etc. Deployment Allowance is ¥840 per day, or ¥1,680 per day in areas where evacuation orders, etc. have been issued. Teacher Special Duty Allowances are set according to the duties covered and the hours worked. This bill revises the allowance amounts and time categories, effective April 1, 2026.
changes: Raises the Disaster Emergency Response, etc. Deployment Allowance from ¥840 to ¥1,080 per day, and sets it at ¥1,620 per day for work from 6 p.m. to 6 a.m. the next day
Raises the allowance for work in areas where evacuation orders, etc. have been issued from ¥1,680 to ¥2,160 per day
Changes the time category for the Teacher Special Duty Allowance from 6 hours to 4 hours, and raises both daily amounts, ¥7,500 and ¥7,000, to ¥8,000
who: City employees engaged in disaster emergency response, etc.
City employees working in areas where evacuation orders, etc. have been issued
Teachers engaged in emergency duties during major disasters, etc.
en.why: The city says the changes are being made to revise the allowance amounts for work on disaster emergency response, etc., and the allowance amounts and time categories for teachers engaged in emergency duties during major disasters, etc.
